name: Kincaid's Cellophane Bee
desc: Kincaid's Cellophane Bee (Colletes kincaidii): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 55 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Colletes kincaidii, or Kincaid's cellophane bee, is a species of hymenopteran in the family Colletidae. It is found in North America.
